title: Android Developer
description:
**Android Developer**

Type of position-Full-Time & In-Office (Gurgaon)

Experience Level- 2+ years

Department-Product Development

**About SuperHuman Race**

In 2016, we started imagining a world where 'good' is valued and rewarded. Based on this lofty mission of making the world a better place, powered by human kindness, we started looking for our answers in data and technology. At the SuperHuman Race, we take pride in using creativity and data to solve intersections. In working out these solutions, we discover the engineers, the architects, and the authors that live and breathe deep inside the colourful fabric of society. We automate social purposes for organisations and deliver impact-related insights to all of our users. At the core of the SuperHuman Race is the belief that while good work is important and aspiring to make an impact is necessary, it cannot be sustainable unless it is also fun!

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an **Android Developer** who is passionate about pushing mobile technologies to their limits. You will work with our team of talented engineers to design, build, and enhance the next generation of our mobile applications. This role will give you the opportunity to work on impactful projects while collaborating with cross-functional teams to create secure, scalable, and user-friendly Android solutions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and build advanced applications for the Android platform.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features.
* Integrate with outside data sources and APIs.
* Unit-test code for robustness, including edge cases, usability, and general reliability.
* Identify and fix bugs while improving overall application performance.
* Continuously discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies to maximise development efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
* Proven software development experience with strong Android development skills.
* At least one original Android app published on the Play Store.
* Hands-on experience with the Android SDK.
* Experience working with remote data via REST and JSON.
* Strong experience with third-party libraries and APIs.
* Solid understanding of the mobile app landscape, architectures, trends, and emerging technologies.
* Clear understanding of the full mobile development life cycle.

**Preferred Skills**

* Familiarity with Android UI/UX design principles and best practices.
* Knowledge of Kotlin in addition to Java.
* Experience with cloud messaging APIs and push notifications.
* Understanding of version control systems (e.g., Git).
* Problem-solving mindset with the ability to think critically about edge cases and scalability.

**Why Join Us?**

* Build mobile applications that create social and environmental impact.
* Work with a talented and purpose-driven team.
* Opportunity to design and implement apps used by communities and organisations worldwide.
* Exposure to cutting-edge technologies and innovation-driven projects.
* 5 Days Working.Informal Dress Code.

**How to apply?**

Send your resume and portfolio (if available) with a brief overview of your work, current CTC & Notice Period details to **neetu@mysuperhumanrace.com**

Subject: *Application for Android Developer*

At SHR, we believe in meritocracy and are proud of the diverse team we have built. We welcome talent from all regions, geographies, languages, backgrounds, cultures, genders, and age groups in our attempt to accelerate progress and deliver on our shared goals of sustainability & equity.

Pay: ₹350,000.00 - ₹500,000.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* This role is full-time and requires working from our office in Gurgaon (5 days/week). Are you comfortable working from the Gurgaon office?
* How many years of professional experience do you have in native Android development?
* Please share the Google Play Store link(s) or GitHub repository link of an original Android application that you have personally built and published.
* Do you have 2+ years of hands-on experience developing native Android apps using Kotlin along with integrating REST APIs/JSON?

title: Client Partner Manager
description:
At Apple, we work every day to create products that enrich people’s lives. We want to help people in every part of their lives that we can, including making the world’s best content easily and beautifully available to the hundreds of millions of people around the globe who use Apple products. Our Advertising Platforms organization enables a thriving ecosystem for content creators, publishers, and developers by helping them monetize their work while enabling users to discover high-quality content seamlessly across Apple devices. With the continued growth of Apple Ads within the App Store where a significant majority of app downloads originate from search this platform has become a critical channel for app discovery and performance marketing for iOS developers globally.
  
  
In this role, you will grow, lead and develop a team that is responsible for revenue generation and customer happiness across your assigned market or region. You’ll use your knowledge of developers, advertisers and agencies to create and maintain positive and productive relationships with marketers of all size and type. You’ll quickly gain the respect and support of both management and other employees by achieving business goals and demonstrating good judgment, business insight, balance, objectivity, collaboration, quiet confidence, and trustworthiness. You will also have direct management responsibility for a team of Client Partners (our client facing sales team) and the Platform Specialists.  
  
**Description**  
The Client Partner Manager (CPM) will lead the Gurgaon team, responsible for sourcing, managing, and growing strategic relationships with leading clients, developers, and agencies. This role requires a strong player-coach leader who can effectively develop and inspire the team while remaining hands-on in managing and expanding relationships with our most strategic customers.  
The CPM will oversee the Client Partner team while also managing the Platform Specialist team, who is responsible for optimizing Apple Ads accounts, maximizing revenue performance, and ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction.  
This role will be responsible for driving a high-performance sales culture that consistently delivers against revenue targets, customer satisfaction (CSI) goals, and key performance metrics such as CPT and CPA. The CPM will lead by example, setting a high standard of execution and ensuring the team delivers extraordinary service and strategic value to all customers.  
The CPM will also ensure strong operational discipline across the team, ensuring the team are reporting their business through the correct channels, utilizing salesforce and other internal business management tools.  
In addition, the role will partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Marketing and Product, to provide market feedback, share customer insights, and inform product development. A strong understanding of the broader digital marketing ecosystem including attribution, viewability, measurement, and competitive dynamics is essential.  
Overall, this is an exciting opportunity to lead a best-in-class sales organization. The CPM will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic partnerships and strengthening client retention, while ensuring the team continues to deliver market-leading service.  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**  
Demonstrated ability to build strong team cultures and to attract, develop, and retain top talent.  
A hands-on player-coach leadership style, with the ability to both lead strategically and actively engage in key client relationships and sales opportunities.  
Strong network and relationships across clients, agencies, and developers.  
Ability to engage and influence stakeholders across all levels from C-suite executives to day-to-day marketing planners.  
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to listen actively, influence cross-functional stakeholders, and clearly articulate strategic business visions internally and externally.  
Proven ability to foster collaboration and drive shared success across cross-functional teams.  
Team-first mindset with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced and dynamic environment while adapting to new business opportunities.  
Highly professional demeanor with a positive and solutions-oriented attitude.  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**  
Bachelors Degree educated, MBA a plus  
Minimum 10 years of experience managing a sales team  
Deep understanding of the mobile app economy and strong passion for the evolving digital marketing landscape.  
Significant experience in online, digital, or performance marketing, ideally within the mobile ecosystem and data-driven marketing environment.  
Solid expertise in performance marketing, including campaign optimization, measurement, and growth strategies.

title: Sales Executive (E-commerce / Mobile Industry)
description:
**Job Description – Sales Executive (E-commerce / Mobile Industry)**

**Company Name:** 1GB Techno Solutions Pvt. Ltd.  
**Job Title:** Sales Executive  
**Department:** Sales / E-commerce  
**Experience Required:** Minimum 3 Years  
**Industry Preference:** Mobile Phones, Consumer Electronics, E-commerce  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a result-oriented **Sales Executive with a minimum of 3 years of experience in the mobile phone industry and e-commerce sales**. The candidate will be responsible for driving mobile phone sales, managing online sales channels, developing business opportunities, and achieving sales targets.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of mobile products, e-commerce operations, sales strategies, pricing, promotional campaigns, and customer relationship management.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive sales of mobile phones and related products through online channels and other relevant sales channels.
* Manage and monitor product listings, pricing, stock availability, and promotional activities across e-commerce platforms.
* Achieve monthly sales targets, revenue goals, and business growth objectives.
* Coordinate with marketplace partners and account managers to improve product visibility, sales performance, and business growth.
* Monitor competitors' pricing, product offerings, discounts, and promotional strategies.
* Analyse sales reports, market trends, inventory movement, and product performance.
* Coordinate with inventory, logistics, and operations teams to ensure timely order fulfilment and stock availability.
* Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to increase sales and market share.
* Maintain strong relationships with marketplace partners, distributors, dealers, retailers, and internal stakeholders.
* Track customer feedback, returns, cancellations, and product-related issues to improve sales performance.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly sales reports and present performance updates to management.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates with a background in Sales, Marketing, or Business Administration will be preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in sales within the mobile phone or consumer electronics industry.
* Prior experience in e-commerce sales, online marketplace operations, or digital sales channels is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of mobile phone products, market trends, pricing, and competitor analysis.
* Understanding of e-commerce sales operations, product listings, inventory management, and promotional campaigns.
* Good communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship-management skills.
* Knowledge in MS Excel, sales reporting, and data analysis.
* Ability to meet sales targets and work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Monthly sales and revenue achievement.
* Growth in mobile phone sales across assigned channels.
* Product visibility and conversion performance.
* Inventory availability and stock movement.
* Sales margin and pricing effectiveness.
* Timely reporting and coordination with internal teams.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

Candidates currently working or previously employed with mobile phone brands, consumer electronics companies, e-commerce businesses, online marketplace sellers, distributors, dealers, or retail organisations will be preferred, particularly those with hands-on experience in mobile phone sales, e-commerce operations, and business development.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates with relevant mobile industry and e-commerce sales experience are invited to apply to **1GB Techno Solutions Pvt. Ltd.**

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
**Mobile Application Developer (Android & iOS) – React Native**

**Job Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 1–3 Years  
**Location:** Gurugram, Haryana  
**Work Mode:** As per company requirements

**Job Description**

We are looking for a skilled Mobile Application Developer with hands-on experience in developing and launching mobile applications for Android and iOS from scratch to production.

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in React Native, API integration, mobile application testing, production deployment, and publishing applications on the Google Play Store and Apple App Store.

The candidate must be capable of managing the complete mobile application lifecycle, from initial development and configuration to store submission, production release, and ongoing maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop mobile applications for Android and iOS from scratch using React Native.
* Build responsive, user-friendly, secure, and high-performance mobile applications.
* Integrate REST APIs, authentication, payment gateways, push notifications, and third-party services.
* Collaborate with backend developers, designers and product teams to implement application features.
* Configure application IDs, bundle IDs, app icons, splash screens, permissions and environment settings.
* Generate signed Android App Bundles (AAB) and prepare production-ready iOS builds.
* Create and manage app listings on Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect.
* Handle app signing, versioning, certificates, provisioning profiles and release configurations.
* Understand developer account verification requirements and the supporting documentation process for both platforms.
* Upload application builds, configure store listings, add screenshots and descriptions, and complete privacy and compliance declarations.
* Manage testing tracks, TestFlight distribution, app submissions, review processes, and production releases.
* Troubleshoot build errors, application crashes, performance issues, and app store rejection issues.
* Maintain existing applications, release updates, fix bugs, and monitor production performance.
* Ensure compliance with Google Play Store and Apple App Store policies.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in mobile application development.
* Hands-on experience with React Native.
* Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience integrating REST APIs and third-party SDKs.
* Knowledge of Git, debugging, testing, and mobile application architecture.
* Practical experience preparing and deploying production-ready Android and iOS applications.
* Familiarity with Google Play Console and Apple App Store Connect.
* Knowledge of Android signing, AAB generation, iOS certificates, and provisioning profiles.
* Understanding of mobile app security, permissions, privacy policies, and store submission requirements.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently.

**Mandatory Experience**

* Must have developed at least one mobile application from scratch to production.
* Must have hands-on experience publishing or managing an Android app release on the Google Play Store.
* Must have experience building and submitting an iOS application to the Apple App Store.
* Must understand app store account setup, verification requirements, document submission, and release workflows.
* Must be able to independently manage app builds, testing, submission, production deployment, and updates.

**Preferred Skills**

* Firebase, push notifications, analytics, and crash reporting.
* CI/CD pipelines and automated mobile builds.
* Knowledge of Kotlin, Java, Swift, or Objective-C.
* Experience resolving app store rejections and maintaining live applications.

Pay: ₹120,000.00 - ₹600,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Internet reimbursement
* Leave encashment
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
* Work from home

**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**


We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

**Job Title**


Software Development Engineering \- Sr Professional II**About your role:**  

At Fiserv, the VisionPLUS developer supports card processing and financial services delivery by enhancing and maintaining VisionPLUS applications in a mainframe environment. This role partners with technology and business teams to deliver functional and technical solutions across key VisionPLUS modules, with a preference for CMS and FAS. The position contributes to application stability, system performance, incident reduction, and successful project delivery across the software development lifecycle.

**What you’ll do:**

* Design, develop, install, support, and maintain VisionPLUS functional solutions, with emphasis on CMS and FAS modules.
* Translate functional requirements into technical designs, program specifications, and production\-ready solutions.
* Partner with engineers, architects, and cross\-functional stakeholders to implement architectural direction and system enhancements.
* Support existing business systems applications and contribute to moderate to complex projects within the functional area.
* Analyze batch flows and system processes to improve performance, reduce complexity, and eliminate redundancy.
* Build, configure, upgrade, and test system environments based on user\-defined requirements for test and production.
* Support storage and capacity planning activities for test and production environments.
* Manage major incidents with internal teams and stakeholders to improve service recovery times and reduce recurring production issues.
* Conduct testing, installation, and production implementation of application changes and provide required technical documentation.
* Communicate issue, incident, and project status with business and technology teams.
* Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all\-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

**Experience you’ll need to have:**

* 4\+ years of experience in VisionPLUS functional and technical design, development, testing, and application support.
* 4\+ years of experience in VisionPLUS modules, preferably CMS and FAS.
* 4\+ years of experience in mainframe technologies including TSO, ISPF, COBOL, JCL, and VSAM.
* 4\+ years of experience in source control and reporting utilities such as Endevor and Easytrieve.
* 4\+ years of experience in full software development lifecycle activities including requirements analysis, technical specification creation, testing, deployment, and production support.
* 4\+ years of experience in batch job analysis, system performance tuning, and production incident support.
* 4\+ years of experience in test environment build, system configuration, installation, and upgrade activities.
* 4\+ years of equivalent combination of educational background, related experience, and/or military experience

**Experience that would be great to have:**

* Experience with network technologies such as SNA, Frame Relay, and TCP/IP.
* Experience supporting card management or issuer processing platforms in a fintech or banking environment.
* Experience working with storage and capacity planning for mainframe test and production environments.
* Experience collaborating with architects and infrastructure teams on platform modernization or system optimization initiatives.
* Experience communicating technical status, risks, and incident updates to business stakeholders.
